_comment: STRUCTURE: Each sprite has id, name, seasonId, rarity, ability, findNotes, levelNotes, variants[], available, new, launchedAt.
VARIANT IDS: normal | gold | cheat-master | loot-hacker | reaper | bounty-hunter | gummy | galaxy | holofoil | gem | cube | quack
AVAILABLE: true = currently obtainable in live matches. false = unreleased or data-mined, not yet in-game.
NEW: true = added in a recent patch, shown in "New Sprites" card on the tracker home.
LAUNCHED_AT: patch date when the sprite went live (e.g. "3-sept-2026" = v42.10, "17-sept-2026" = v42.20).
SEASON IDS: c7-s4 = Chapter 7 Season 4 (Override), c7-s3 = Chapter 7 Season 3 (Archive).
--- Base sprites: bush, adventure, 8-bit, jonesy, killswitch, sonic, tails, shadow, jackrabbit, crown, klombo, xray, mega-man, overshield, onigiri, storm-scout ---
--- Each base sprite has: normal, gold, cheat-master variants (3 variants per base) ---
--- Loot Hacker variants: separate sprite entries with id prefix "loot-hacker-" ---
--- Gold variants (v42.20): separate entries with id prefix "gold-" for crash-bandicoot, blinky, pond, morgana, birthday ---
--- Cheat Master variants (v42.20): separate entries with id prefix "cheat-master-" ---
--- Bounty Hunter variants (v42.20): separate entries with id prefix "bounty-hunter-" (unreleased, available: false) ---
--- Bounty Hunter Crown is the only available bounty-hunter sprite (reaper variant) ---
--- Unreleased v42.20 sprites (available: false): morgana, birthday, phase-dash, head-shot, all bounty-hunter-* except crown ---

--- Archived sprites: s3-batman, s3-air, s3-aura, s3-earth, s3-fire, s3-water, s3-ghost, s3-llama, s3-peeky-peely, s3-zero-point, s3-fishy, s3-demon, s3-king, s3-john-wick, s3-duck, s3-dream, s3-punk, s3-vini-jr, s3-burnt-peanut, s3-striker, s3-boss, s3-grim, s3-seven, s3-ironmouse, s3-pollo ---
--- Each archive sprite has: normal, gold, gummy, galaxy, holofoil/gem/cube/quack variants ---

name: Blinky

name: Pond

levelNotes: Healing effectiveness increases with each level up.
